name: Fragmented Charge
body:
You gain additional options with your fragmented step.

Prerequisite(s): shattersoul, fragmented step species trait, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): You can use your fragmented step ability one additional time per day. When you use fragmented step, you can choose to use it as a full-round action to move up 60 feet instead of the normal 30 feet. If you end your movement adjacent to an opponent, you can choose to apply your fragmented step damage to that opponent as well, even if you did not move through that opponent’s square.
